entry.title: New: Resolution 494 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 494-26 & FC-137 - 04/22/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR REAL PROPERTY TO BE USED BY THE HAWAIʻI FIRE DEPARTMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with Maui Varieties Investments, Inc., with an estimated cost of $2,547.23 per month, for two units located at 95-1163 Kaʻalaiki Road.
